name: obsidian1
description: A local-first, extensible knowledge management web application inspired by Obsidian. Features bi-directional linking, knowledge graph visualization, CodeMirror 6 editor with Live Preview, and a professional 3-column workspace layout.
conventions: All components use named exports, never default exports
State management via Zustand stores in /src/stores/*.ts
Zod schemas validate all external input
Web Workers for CPU-intensive tasks (search indexing, graph physics)
architecture_patterns: Local-first: File System Access API as primary storage, IndexedDB fallback
In-memory metadata cache with event-driven reactivity
Server Components for static shell, Client Components for interactive workspace
Separation of concerns: data layer → stores → UI components

file_structure.src/app: Next.js App Router pages and layouts
file_structure.src/app/vault: Main workspace layout (after vault is opened)
file_structure.src/components/editor: CodeMirror 6 editor and CM6 extensions (wikilinks, live-preview, frontmatter)
file_structure.src/components/ui: shadcn/ui primitives (Button, Dialog, Input, Command, etc.)
file_structure.src/components/workspace: Shell components (Ribbon, Sidebars, TabBar, StatusBar, CommandPalette)
file_structure.src/lib/vault: Core engine: filesystem abstraction, metadata cache, search index
file_structure.src/stores: Zustand reactive stores (Vault, Metadata, Workspace, Theme)
file_structure.src/workers: Web Workers for search indexing and graph physics

patterns: Unit tests for vault filesystem and metadata cache
Unit tests for Zustand store logic
Component tests for editor and workspace UI
Integration tests for vault CRUD operations

sprint_focus: Building the core MVP: CodeMirror 6 editor with wikilinks, file explorer, backlinks panel, graph view, and 3-column workspace layout.
never_do: Never use useEffect for data fetching — use Server Components or Zustand subscriptions
Never store secrets in .env files committed to git
Never use inline styles — always use Tailwind classes
Never use `any` TypeScript type — always type explicitly
Never put business logic in React components — use lib/ or stores/
Never block the main thread with heavy computation — use Web Workers
Never use default exports for components — always use named exports
preferred_patterns: Use Zustand for all global state management
Use CodeMirror 6 extensions for editor features
Use shadcn/ui + Radix for accessible UI primitives
Use Web Workers for search indexing and graph physics
